title: Choose the creator links design
question: All three make the linked product unmistakable. Choose the composition that should define the creator Links page.

options.label: Active Product Gallery
options.lineage: visual product catalog with an operational link footer
options.thesis: Creators recognize products from imagery first, then copy or manage the exact link beneath each one.
options.viewport: A category band and compact filter row lead into a three-column gallery; every product card ends with a clearly separated tracking-link strip and Copy action.
options.risk: Beautiful and familiar, but it shows fewer links per viewport than the list-based option.

options.label: Editorial Link Ledger
options.lineage: premium commerce list crossed with a precise link register
options.thesis: Each link becomes one calm product row whose image, identity, terms, status, and URL read in a single scan.
options.viewport: A product-type navigator and search filters sit above full-width image-led rows; product identity dominates the left and a restrained link utility rail anchors the right.
options.risk: The most efficient and professional option, but it relies on excellent spacing to avoid feeling table-like.

options.label: Product Link Passports
options.lineage: product passport cards with a creator-owned link identity
options.thesis: Every product and its tracking link are presented as one complete, self-contained object.
options.viewport: Filters lead into a two-column grid of generous passport cards with product photography, brand and category, exact commission, status, visible URL, Copy, and a clear product-detail destination.
options.risk: It gives every link exceptional clarity, but long URLs and Georgian labels need disciplined responsive handling.
